name: dsh-mcp-tools
description: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add streamable-HTTP or stdio MCP servers in the Settings page, paste Postman-style request headers for auth, run a connectivity test, and toggle individual MCP tools so disabled ones never reach the model. Servers live in a single settings panel with JSON import; state is stored atomically in ~/.dsh/dsh-mcp-tools/state.json (documented as credential-equivalent because headers may hold API keys).
